title: OptiBoost Plus
description: OptiBoost Plus is a Minecraft performance modpack that boosts FPS, reduces lag, and optimizes memory for smooth gameplay on both low-end and high-end PCs
body:
# OptiBoost Plus Performance Modpack
# 
OptiBoost is a highly optimized Minecraft 26.1.1 modpack built for maximum performance, stability, and smooth gameplay on all types of PCs.

## ⚙️ Core Optimization

FPS boost focused configuration
Reduced lag, stutters, and micro-freezes
Faster chunk loading system
Optimized memory (RAM) usage
Lightweight background process handling
Improved entity and world rendering performance

## 💻 Low-End PC Support

Designed for Intel HD Graphics and 4–8GB RAM systems
Minimal visual strain for stable performance
Reduced particles, shadows, and effects
Smooth survival gameplay even on weak hardware
Stable FPS range: ~20–60 FPS depending on system


## 🚀 High-End PC Optimization

Enhanced rendering efficiency for ultra settings
Better lighting and visual smoothness
High render distance support
Shader-friendly performance tuning
Stable high FPS gameplay (100+ FPS depending on hardware)


## 🎮 Gameplay Experience

Lightweight, performance-first mod selection
Works smoothly in Survival, PvP, and Creative modes
Multiplayer/server optimized
Reduced crashes and improved stability
Balanced visuals vs performance tuning

OptiBoost is built for one purpose:
to make Minecraft 26.1.1 run faster, smoother, and more stable on both weak and powerful systems without unnecessary performance loss.
